name: BGE M3
description: BAAI bge-reranker-v2-m3 is a 0.6B-parameter multilingual reranking model built on bge-m3. It scores query-document relevance for retrieval and RAG pipelines with an 8,192-token input window and fast inference.

name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
description: DeepSeek's official V4 Flash release with substantially enhanced agentic capabilities and a built-in speculative decoding module. A 304B-parameter MoE with ~13B active per token, it outperforms DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) on agentic benchmarks at a fraction of the compute, with a 1M-token context window.

name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a mixture-of-experts model with 552B backbone parameters, a one-million-token context window, and support for reasoning and tool calling.

name: GLM 5.2
description: GLM-5.2 is Z.ai's flagship model for long-horizon tasks, sustaining agentic work across a solid 1M-token context. It offers stronger coding with flexible thinking-effort levels and an improved MTP layer for faster speculative decoding, under an MIT license.

name: GLM 5.3
description: GLM-5.3 shares its base model with GLM-5.2 and takes its gains from post-training, with substantially stronger complex coding and long-horizon agentic work. Served at NVFP4 across a 1M-token context.

name: GLM 5.3 Flash
description: Z.ai's first natively multimodal GLM-5 model: a 320B-parameter MoE with ~18B active per token, combining sparse and linear attention for cheap long-context serving across a 1M-token window. Outperforms GLM-5.2 on coding and agentic work at a fraction of the price, with three-level reasoning-effort control, under an MIT license.

name: GLM 5
description: Z.ai's GLM-5, a 744B-parameter MoE flagship for agentic reasoning and coding, served in FP8.

name: Laguna S 2.1
description: Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 8B activated parameters per token, designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work. It sits between Laguna XS 2.1 (33B-A3B) and Laguna M.1 (225B-A23B) in the Laguna series and shares the family recipe: a token-choice router with softplus gating over 256 routed experts plus one shared expert, grouped-query attention, and interleaved full/sliding-window attention.

name: Laya
description: Laya is a decision model: a ModernBERT encoder with a decision head that scores every allowed answer in a single forward pass, without generating text. Given a state and typed questions (yes/no, a choice among options, or a score on 2 to 10 levels), it returns a calibrated probability for every answer. Served on /v1/systemone, compatible with TypeSafe's decision API. English states are read up to 512 tokens; states in other languages go to its multilingual checkpoint automatically, read up to 1,024 tokens. Longer states are truncated.

name: Mica v0.1 4B
description: Mica v0.1 4B is a 4B-parameter decision model built on Qwen3.5-4B. Given a state and typed questions (yes/no, a choice among up to 255 options, or a score on 2 to 10 levels), it returns a calibrated probability for every allowed answer from a single read of the input, without generating text. Served on /v1/systemone, compatible with TypeSafe's decision API. Trained on English and Korean; inputs up to 8,192 tokens.

name: MiMo V2.6 Flash RL
description: MiMo V2.6 Flash RL is Xiaomi's efficiency-balanced mixture-of-experts model with 309B total and 15B active parameters, hybrid sliding-window attention, and a 1M-token context. Supports reasoning and tool calling, served at FP8.

name: MiMo V2.6 Pro RL
description: MiMo V2.6 Pro RL is Xiaomi's mixture-of-experts model with 1.02T total and 42B active parameters, hybrid sliding-window attention, and a 1M-token context. Supports reasoning and tool calling, served at FP8.

name: MiniMax M3
description: MiniMax M3 is a natively multimodal MoE model (~428B parameters, ~23B active) with a 1M-token context. MiniMax Sparse Attention delivers up to 9x prefill and 15x decode speedups at long context, with frontier-level performance on long-horizon coding and agentic benchmarks.

name: Muse Glimmer 30B
description: Muse Glimmer 30B is a dense multimodal model for reasoning, coding, and tool use, with a 131072-token context. Supports text and image input, and video processed as individual frames, with text output.

name: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is a multimodal large language model that unifies video, audio, image, and text understanding to support enterprise-grade Q&A, summarization, transcription, and document intelligence workflows.

name: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety
description: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety model is a small language model fine-tuned from Gemma-3-4B-it for multimodal, multilingual content moderation. It classifies prompts, images, and responses against a standard safety taxonomy or a user-supplied custom policy, with optional reasoning traces.

name: Qwen3 Embedding 4B
description: Qwen3 Embedding 4B is a 4B-parameter multilingual text embedding model built on Qwen3. It produces 2,560-dimension embeddings, truncatable to fewer dimensions, for retrieval and RAG pipelines with a 32k-token context. Set input_type to search_query on queries for its query instruction.

name: Qwen 3.8 27B
description: Qwen3.8-27B is the most capable compact dense model in the Qwen open-model family: a native vision-language model that understands images and video, with flexible thinking control and substantial gains in coding, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.

name: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next
description: Qwen3.8 Flash Next with NVFP4 weights, a 262,144-token context window, reasoning, and tool calling.

name: SemIf (Qwen 3.5 4B)
description: SemIf reads stock Qwen3.5-4B as a decision model: given a state and typed questions (yes/no, a choice among up to 16 options, or a score on 2 to 10 levels), it returns a probability for every allowed answer from a single read of the input, without generating text. Ranked second on JevBench, the best open decision system there. Served on /v1/systemone, compatible with TypeSafe's decision API. Inputs up to 4,096 tokens.

name: Vultron Retriever Core 4.5B
description: Vultr's Vultron Retriever Core is a 4.5B-parameter reranking model built on Qwen 3.5. It scores query-document relevance for retrieval and RAG pipelines, balancing accuracy and throughput with a 262k-token context.

name: Vultron Retriever Flash 0.8B
description: Vultr's Vultron Retriever Flash is a lightweight 0.8B-parameter reranking model built on Qwen 3.5, optimized for low-latency, high-volume query-document relevance scoring in retrieval and RAG pipelines.

name: Whisper Large V3 Turbo
description: Whisper Large V3 Turbo is OpenAI's 809M-parameter speech recognition model, a pruned large-v3 with a 4-layer decoder for fast multilingual transcription. Send audio up to 25 MB and 10 minutes to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Priced per second of audio.

name: Z-Image Turbo
description: Z-Image Turbo is Tongyi-MAI's efficient 6B-parameter single-stream diffusion transformer for text-to-image generation, producing high-quality images in as few as 8 steps for very low latency.
